jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595
jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise. * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage. * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics. * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required. * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus. * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems. * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).
